capabilities: Render dictation timestamps as localized bold dates
Label the start and end of insertion locations
Render Markdown inside dictatebar fenced blocks
Configure date format, time format and separator visibility
Keep the original Markdown source unchanged
disambiguation: Not a dictation or speech-to-text tool; it only formats dictations already captured by the Dictate Bar app.
extras: Desktop only, Obsidian 1.15.1 or later; mobile is not supported. Reading view is the primary supported surface, and Windows, Linux, Live Preview and PDF export are unverified. The plugin makes no network requests and does not write to note files.
motivation: To bring a reading experience inspired by Dictate Bar's Dictations Viewer into Obsidian.
problem: Dictate Bar saves dictations as Markdown with raw ISO timestamps and insertion markers, which read poorly in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: A small companion plugin that brings Dictate Bar's readable dictations into an Obsidian vault.

summary: Companion plugin that renders Dictate Bar dictations in Obsidian with localized bold timestamps, labeled location boundaries and native Markdown.
